input.narrative: Confirmed IS_WINDOWS is set to sys.platform == "win32" (fixed from !=) on line 7 of _ipc.py. The defect was that the original code used `!= "win32"` which evaluates True on POSIX systems, causing spawn_kwargs() to access Windows-only subprocess constants (CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP, CREATE_NO_WINDOW) and raising AttributeError on the test runner platform.
